_comment: Module catalogue: every known TerraPulse module. `order` sets daemon start order (low first). A machine's role (etc/enabled.json, set by `terrapulse setup --role`) picks which of these are enabled.

modules.name: tpmaster
modules.description: Central message broker and storage coordinator

modules.name: tpinv
modules.description: Publish accelerometer inventory to the broker (runs once, then exits)

modules.name: tpslinkserver
modules.description: SeedLink backbone: ring buffer + record feed + serve

modules.name: tpqc
modules.description: Latency, gap, spike and availability metrics

modules.name: tpalert
modules.description: Alert generation from anomalies and events

modules.name: tpmap
modules.description: Live structure map, inspired by scmv

modules.name: tpmv
modules.description: Map view alias for tpmap, inspired by scmv/scmvx

modules.name: tprttv
modules.description: Real-time acceleration traces, inspired by scrttv

modules.name: tpolv
modules.description: Operator event review, inspired by scolv
